summary.text: Sandra Hollins is a Democratic member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 21 in Salt Lake County, serving since January 1, 2015. The Legislature's roster lists her as a licensed clinical social worker.

paragraphs.text: Hollins earned a B.S. in business management from the University of Phoenix and an M.S. in social work from the University of Utah, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
The roster lists her affiliations as the Greater Salt Lake Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, the National Association of Social Workers and the Fair Park Community Council.
